findings.summary: Prior final-review major (rf-1b7b1b3a) is addressed: _persist_append now tracks per-file directory-entry durability via _files_synced (a second goal's file in the same directory re-syncs its parent), _created_dirs/_dir_synced re-derive still-unsynced ancestor entries after a partial failure, and _rewrite_clean syncs the parent directory after its atomic rename. Three offline tests pin the requested paths (second-file entry resync, entry-sync failure-injection rollback/resync, repair-rename directory sync).

Read-only mechanical identity verified: worktree HEAD is 049d0378..., whose reflog parent is the product/work_head commit 824ba058... (metadata-only materialization, .dev-dispatch only), consistent with the implement handoff. Handoff records compileall exit 0 and focused pytest 108 passed, not independently re-run here. Live Runtime binding, reply delivery, process stop/resume, full Session query and joint E2E remain deferred per development-stage constraints and are not grounds for this verdict.
